author: Arnav
problem: Read N distinct points with integer coordinates. Print how many ways there are to choose three of them that form a triangle with positive area.
bug_description: The right side of the cross-product test uses the x-gap (XY[j][0]-XY[i][0]) where it needs the y-gap (XY[j][1]-XY[i][1]), so the collinearity test is wrong.

comments.accurate: Counts triples of points that are not collinear, using a cross-product check
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts triples whose first two points aren't vertically aligned and whose third point is off the 45-degree line through the first
comments.wrong_location: Collinearity test verified; check the triple loops don't count the same set of points twice
